<?php
$escaped156Review = null;
$given156Review = new Exception("ctor");
$destination156Review = 99;
try {
    $destination156Review = new class($given156Review) {
        public $value = 7;
        public function __construct($error) {
            global $escaped156Review;
            echo "ctor|";
            $escaped156Review = $this;
            throw $error;
        }
        public function __destruct() { echo "destruct|"; }
    };
} catch (Exception $error) {
    echo $error === $given156Review ? "caught|" : "wrong|";
}
echo $destination156Review, "|", $escaped156Review->value, "|manual-before|";
$escaped156Review->__destruct();
echo "manual-after|";
unset($escaped156Review);
echo "after|";

<?php
function fail156Review() {
    global $unwind156Review;
    $local = new class {
        public function __destruct() {
            echo "destroy|";
            throw new Exception("replacement");
        }
    };
    throw $unwind156Review;
}
$unwind156Review = new Exception("original");
try {
    fail156Review();
} catch (Exception $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
    echo $error->getPrevious() === $unwind156Review ? "previous|" : "wrong|";
    echo $unwind156Review->getPrevious() === null ? "original-clean|" : "changed|";
}
echo "after|";

<?php
echo "start|";
$first156 = new class {
    public $value = 1;
    function __destruct() { echo "alias|", $this->value, "|"; }
};
$other156 = $first156;
unset($first156);
echo "held|";
$other156->value = 2;
unset($other156);
echo "released|";
new class { public function __destruct() { echo "temporary|"; } };
echo "after";

<?php
$source156 = 'namespace Destruct156Author;
function make156() {
    return new class {
        public $tag = 1;
        public function __destruct() { echo "eval|", $this->tag, "|"; }
    };
}';
eval($source156);
$first156 = Destruct156Author\make156();
$second156 = Destruct156Author\make156();
$first156->tag = 4;
$second156->tag = 5;
unset($first156);
echo "between|";
unset($second156);
echo "after";

<?php
$first156 = new class {
    public function __destruct() { echo "first|"; }
};
$second156 = new class {
    function __destruct() { echo "second|"; }
};
echo "body|";
